buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: N/A 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): 1. Past Performance 2. Handloom Registration certificate 3. BID specific authorization . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA NFR MLG payable at Maligaon . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C PFA NFR MLG . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA NFR MLG

payable at Maligaon . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA NFR MLG A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Handloom Mark Condition: a. Each Pillow Cover supplied should have the Handloom Mark. b. The OEM s hould have Handloom Mark in his own name. In case of authorized dealer of OEM , Tender sp ecific authori zation letter from OEM to be attached along with the Bid. Firm should upload Handloom Mark certification by Textile committee along with the Bid. c. Either OEM having Handloom Mark or their authorized dealer c an submit the offer. Both OEM having Han dloom Mark and their authorized dealer cannot bid simultaneou sly. In such cases both the offers will be co nsidered ineligible and will be summarily rejected. d. OEM havi ng Handloom Mark may note that either OEM or an agent can represent only one firm in a tend er and they cannot submit more than one offer against a tender through different sole selling agents. In su ch a situati on all the offers will be rejected. e. The onus of submission of handloom mark registration certificate issue d by textile committee along with offer shall lie with bidder. 2. Past Performance: The Manufacturer, Authorized Agent (Through their Principals) or Apex Society should have supplied same or similar item (similar means Pillow Cover Handloom of same specification but differe nt size/shade/colour) for 20% of bid quantity in at least one of the last three financial years and current fin ancial year till the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. (a) For fulfilling the Pas t Performance criteria, any one of the following documents shall be considered as v alid proof for meeting t he Past Performance criteria: - (i) For GeM contracts, CRAC to be attached. (ii) Execution certificate by clie nt with order value & quantity along with copy of the Purchase/Supply Orde r. (iii) Any other document in s upport of order execution like Third Party Inspection, Release note, R Notes et c. along with copy of Purcha se/Supply Order. (b) In case tenderers participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as require d above shall be that of the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentia ls of past supply f or a different Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing order in case of change of Principal. (c) The quantity of item supplied in the past though ACASH by a Handloom uni t will also be considered as the supply performance of their Handloom unit. For considering the supply perf ormance through ACASH, t he bidder should upload Supply Orders of ACASH on them along with supply do cuments like R-Note, Inspe ction Certificate etc. (d) Firms without requisite performance criteria or firms w ho have not attached documents, as mentioned above, in support of past performance shall be ignored. O nly firm with required performance, as mentione d in bid performance criteria, shall be considered for plac

ement of order. 3. Sample Approval: After receipt of P.O. the firm should submit 03 (three) nos. samples within 10 days pr eferably from the issue of P.O. to the Dy.CMM/DBRT for approval of general appearance, lustre, feel, finish and shade of the Pillow C over cotton before bulk manufacturing. Dy.CMM/DBRT, on approval, will keep on e no. approved sample with him, and send one no. approved sample directly to inspecting authority (R ITE S) for guidance during inspection and the remaining one approved sample shall be handed over to the sup plier. 4. Inspection: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises: By RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee sit e before acceptance of stores: By CONSIGNEE It shall be mandated that testing of the material shall be co nducted, irrespective of the inspection agency, at the NABL accredited lab before dispatch of material, and not in the premises of manufacturer or supplie r. 5. Settlement of Disputes: As per clause 2900 of Indian Railway Standard (IRS) Conditions of Contract S ept ember 2022 Version 1.0 (or latest) 6. Required Documents:- Firm must attach following documents along with any other document(s) require d against this bid– 1. Documents in support of MSE registration (if applicable). 2. Documents as per Make i n India policy. 3. In case of authorized dealer, firm must attach bid specific authorization from OEM. 4. Doc uments in support of Past Performance. 5. Handloom Mark eligibility certificate .
